meta.title: GenAI at work — extraction check
meta.tagline: One exhibit of the paper, every cited cell as printed against the unit it was read into; the cells the extraction missed added.
meta.description: The extraction-check pass of the GenAI-at-work validation as a review template over the pipeline's record: the drawn exhibit as the head, its transcribed cells beneath with the estimate each fed, a verdict on value and mapping per cell, a row for every cell the extraction missed, and a full-review flag for the paper.

stages.label: Cells
stages.help: One exhibit of this paper, drawn at random among those the extraction read estimates from; its transcription is in the pane, its page tag opens it in the PDF. For every row: is the value exactly as printed, and is the cell an estimate of the unit named? Add a row (＋) for a cell of this exhibit that estimates an AI-versus-reference contrast and is not listed (leave its Estimate blank). Press done; set *Full review needed* when what you saw makes the paper's whole extraction doubtful.

questions.name: value_ok
questions.label: Value right?
questions.help: is the value (and SE) exactly what the exhibit prints in that cell?

questions.name: mapping_ok
questions.label: Mapping right?
questions.help: is this cell an estimate of that unit (those arms, that outcome, subgroup and horizon)?

fields.name: estimate_id
fields.label: Estimate
fields.help: the estimate the cell should have fed, when there is one

questions.name: full_review
questions.label: Full review needed
questions.help: yes when what you saw makes the whole extraction of this paper doubtful; say why
